widget.doc: Paging for a list or for pages of content: "Page 1 of 3" with previous and next buttons; Pager bind:page count:{ceil(length(rows)/5)} keeps the page (from 0) in your number variable, so show slice(rows,page*5,page*5+5), or give it the variable of Pages or a Carousel to turn their pages. A count of zero hides the pager.
